Subject: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing / dashboards — pricing details?

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the demo last week. We sketched out an internal plan to lean on Redwood for model inference and to add the observability suite (longer retention for traces, higher sampling for a few services, and the advanced dashboards for our SRE/ML infra teams). Before we loop in procurement, can you send a clear price breakdown for:

- Tracing ingest (per million spans) and storage for hot/nearline retention tiers
- Retention pricing (90 days hot, 730 days cold) and any archival/restore fees
- Advanced dashboards (per-seat vs per-instance options), and expected dashboard query/compute surcharges if any
- Pilot terms: trial credits, length, and any constraints (e.g., volume caps)

We're targeting a pilot that generates ~25M spans/day and ~12 TB/month of trace-related storage. Goal is a 12-month committed deployment if economics look reasonable. Also please flag any SLA or seat surcharges.

I've attached a short set of questions and our projected usage.

Thanks,
Ethan

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Observability pricing options (pricing grid attached)

Michael — draft pricing and concession options below, based on their stated run rates. I included a conservative estimate and two commit tiers. See attached pricing_grid_v3.xlsx for line-item math.

Summary (list prices):
- Tracing ingest: $0.40 per million spans ingested (indexing + storage pre-processing)
- Hot retention (90 days): $0.035 per GB-month
- Cold retention (archival up to 730 days): $0.007 per GB-month (restore fee $40 per TB restore)
- Advanced dashboards: $650 / month per dashboard instance (unlimited viewers) OR $12 / month per seat for managed viewer seats (query compute billed separately)
- Query/compute: $0.12 per dashboard-query-unit (approx equals 100 query-seconds on our cluster)
- Seat surcharge: $75 / seat / month typical — can waive for enterprise commit as concession

Concession paths (commercial examples):
- Pilot: 3 months free credits up to $10,000 (consumable across ingest/storage/dash compute)
- 12-mo commit (minimum $120k ARR): 20% off list for observability add-ons + pilot credits above; seat surcharge waived for first 12 months
- 24-mo commit (minimum $240k ARR): 30% off list + 1 month DSAT (discount) for transition costs + waived restore fees for first year

Notes / risk items for legal:
- If they require explicit data residency in a single VPC region, there may be a one-time migration/setup fee ($8k–$15k) depending on region and isolation.
- SOC 2 evidence: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report within our standard NDA/program.

Suggested next step to close: present a single-sheet commercial (PDF) that shows list pricing, the 12-mo commit scenario with discount, and a pilot statement of work. If procurement pushes, we can offer a mid-point concession: 18% instead of 20% and keep pilot credits intact.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference
